activities.name: Timpanogos Cave National Monument
activities.bio: A cave system in American Fork Canyon reached by a steep paved trail. Guided tours show off colorful formations, and tickets usually need to be booked ahead.

activities.name: Bridal Veil Falls
activities.bio: A two-tiered waterfall tucked into Provo Canyon. It is a short walk from the parking area, which makes it an easy stop with friends any time of year.
activities.imageAlt: Bridal Veil Falls in Provo Canyon

activities.name: Thanksgiving Point
activities.bio: A Lehi campus with large gardens, a farm, and a natural history museum. Easy to spend a whole afternoon walking around together.

activities.name: Utah Lake State Park
activities.bio: A Provo marina on one of the biggest lakes in Utah. Rent a kayak or paddleboard, go fishing, or watch the sunset over the water.
activities.imageAlt: Boats at Utah Lake State Park marina

activities.name: Seven Peaks Water Park
activities.bio: A Provo water park with slides and a wave pool. It is seasonal, so check the opening dates before you plan a group trip.
activities.imageAlt: Water slides at Seven Peaks Water Park

activities.name: Rock Canyon Trail
activities.bio: A popular Provo trail that leads into a canyon right at the edge of town. Short enough for an evening hike, with views of the valley.

activities.name: Sundance Mountain Resort
activities.bio: A resort in Provo Canyon known for skiing in winter and for hiking and scenic views the rest of the year.

activities.name: SCERA Shell Outdoor Theatre
activities.bio: An outdoor amphitheater in Orem that hosts summer concerts, movies, and shows. Bring a blanket and enjoy a night out with friends.
activities.imageAlt: Audience at the SCERA Shell Outdoor Theatre

activities.name: Provo River Trail
activities.bio: A paved trail that follows the Provo River through Provo and into the canyon. Good for walking, biking, or an easy evening stroll with friends.
activities.imageAlt: Paved trail beside the Provo River

activities.name: Springville Museum of Art
activities.bio: A Springville museum known for its collection of Utah artists and rotating exhibits. A relaxed indoor option when the weather is bad.
activities.imageAlt: Front of the Springville Museum of Art
